question: The scout troop collected 4 sacks of cans for the deposit scheme, with 115 cans in each sack. Half of the cans turned out to be the wrong type and were sent to ordinary recycling, and the troop then gave 73 of the good cans to a rival troop that was short. The troop took the rest to the deposit machine, which paid 5 cents for every can. A passer-by then donated 59 cents to the troop's tin, and a shopkeeper added 67 cents. How many cents did the troop have in its tin?

A vineyard is planted with 214 vines in every row, 8 rows in every block, and 9 blocks across the estate. The owner, who has run the vineyard for a dozen years, also planted 30 vines along the driveway, 61 vines around the house, and 7 vines by the gate. How many vines are there on the estate?

Ana's allotment plot gave her 210 kilograms of vegetables last season, plus 20 kilograms of herbs. Her friend Bo's plot is far more productive: it gives 4 times as much as Ana's whole plot did in a season. Bo has 4 plots that each produce that amount, and each of them gives 4 harvests a year. How many kilograms do Bo's plots produce in a year?

Fen had 139 dollars, received 35 dollars for her birthday, and then spent 158 dollars on a jacket. Her brother Gil earns 2 times as much in a day as Fen had left after buying the jacket, so Gil's daily pay is more than Fen's remaining money. Gil worked 8 days this fortnight. He then spent 115 dollars on a train ticket and 4 dollars on a coffee. How many dollars does Gil have left from this fortnight's pay?

Hana's coin jar receives 73 cents from each of the 8 people in her house every Monday, plus a 28-cent contribution from the neighbour's boy. Every week she takes 430 cents out of the jar for the shared milk order and puts 72 cents of bottle refunds back in. That weekly amount is more than her friend Ivo manages to save in his own jar. She kept exactly to this pattern for 4 weeks, starting from an empty jar. Hana counts in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents are in the jar after those 4 weeks?

Lia's small farm produces 191 kilograms of tomatoes a week. Max's farm produces 3 times as much per week as Lia's does, so Max's harvest is far larger, and Max also picks 57 kilograms of cherry tomatoes each week. The season lasts 9 weeks, and Max sells 4938 kilograms of his season's crop to a cannery. He sells every remaining kilogram at the farm gate for 2 dollars a kilogram. How many dollars does Max make at the farm gate?

The bake sale started with 201 cupcakes on the main table, but 14 were eaten by the helpers and 33 more were brought in by a late parent. There were 5 tables at the sale, each with exactly the same number of cupcakes as the main table. The sale ran for 3 hours. At the end, all of the cupcakes were shared equally among 4 charities. How many cupcakes did the hospice charity receive?

Ola had 184 dollars in her savings jar. For her birthday her grandfather doubled what was in the jar, and her aunt added 10 dollars. Ola then took 340 dollars out of the jar to buy a laptop. After that her mother put 69 dollars into the jar for good exam results. How many dollars are in Ola's jar now?

Pat had 133 cents in his pocket, spent 38 cents on a stamp, and then found 13 cents in the car. His cousin Quil had 5 times as many cents as Pat had at that point, so Quil was the richer of the two. Quil then earned 42 cents returning a shopping trolley and spent 579 cents on a book. Quil counts in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents does Quil have left?

In the morning Rob picked 20 plums from the garden tree, and his sister Sue picked 2 times as many plums as Rob did, so Sue's basket was fuller. Sue split her plums equally into 2 bags and gave 1 bag to their grandmother. In the afternoon Sue picked 58 more plums. In the evening she divided all the plums she had equally into 3 jars for jam, and then used 18 plums from the first jar for a pie. How many plums are left in the first jar?

Val's craft stall took in 101 dollars on Saturday, but she had to give a 42-dollar refund, and then a late customer spent 65 dollars. Wes's stall takes in 7 times as much in a day as Val's did that Saturday, so Wes is doing far better than Val. Wes traded for 6 days at that daily rate. How many dollars did Wes take in over those 6 days?

In the morning a fruit seller opened 4 crates of apples with 177 apples in each and sold 595 apples before lunch, then found 10 apples in the bottom of an empty crate. In the afternoon he threw away 12 bruised apples and sold every remaining apple at 9 cents each. In the evening he paid 708 cents to the farmer for the crates. He keeps his books in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents did the seller have left from the afternoon's sales after paying the farmer?

Yui's bakery bakes 8 trays of pastries every morning with 177 pastries on each tray. Zac's bakery, which is much bigger, bakes twice as many pastries each morning as Yui's does. This morning Zac gave 228 pastries to a homeless shelter, sold 2305 pastries to customers, and threw away 257 pastries that had burned. How many pastries does Zac have left?

On Saturday morning Cara's bakery had 193 loaves on its shelves, which was more than Ben's bakery next door had baked, and it sold 176 loaves before noon. In the afternoon Cara sold 11 more loaves and dropped 1 loaf on the floor, which had to be thrown away. In the evening a customer returned 4 loaves that had been ordered by mistake, and Cara cut every loaf still on the shelves into 2 halves to sell at the night market. How many half-loaves did Cara take to the night market?

In the morning Fia had 20 cookies in her lunchbox and gave half of them to her friend. In the afternoon her mother refilled the box so that Fia had twice as many cookies as she had after sharing, and then Fia ate half of what was in the box. In the evening her grandmother baked 29 cookies and put them all in the box. How many cookies are in Fia's lunchbox now?

A film crew shot 148 minutes of footage for a series and divided it equally among 4 episodes. From the first episode the editor cut an 8-minute scene and an 18-minute scene, then added 72 minutes of newly shot material after a dozen days of reshoots. The editor logs footage in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes long is the first episode now?

Gia's factory runs 8 identical machines, each producing 132 bottle caps an hour, and a worker adds 3 caps an hour by hand. The factory has 40 workers in all. The machines run 7 hours a day, 3 days a week, and the order runs for 9 weeks, which is more caps than Hal's rival factory could make in that time. Of the caps made for the order, 95661 failed inspection and were scrapped. How many caps passed inspection?

On Saturday morning Ike set up his fruit stall with 5 boxes of oranges, 109 oranges in each box. Jay's stall across the aisle had 9 times as many oranges as Ike's, so Jay had by far the bigger display. Jay's stall is 4 metres long. In the afternoon Jay sold 4849 oranges to a juice company. In the evening he gave 51 oranges to the market cleaners. How many oranges did Jay have left?

Kit's front flower bed has 135 tulips, 27 daffodils, and 66 crocuses. She has 3 beds altogether, and the other beds are planted exactly the same way, which took her a dozen weekends. For the spring fair she cut 621 flowers from the beds, and after that 71 new flowers opened. How many flowers are in Kit's beds now?

In the morning 4 lorries arrived at the building site, each carrying 8 pallets with 196 bricks on every pallet, and the bricklayers used 4896 bricks before lunch. The site is 15 kilometres from the brickworks. In the afternoon a labourer found 37 bricks in an old skip and added them to the stock, and 21 bricks were broken by a forklift. In the evening the foreman sold every brick left in the stock to a neighbouring site at 6 cents a brick. How many cents did the foreman receive?

In the morning Nat had 119 flyers for the school play and handed out 48 of them at the bus stop. The print shop then gave her 2 times as many flyers as she had left, replacing her stack with the larger one. In the afternoon she handed out 73 flyers at the shopping centre. In the evening her friend gave her 74 flyers that had been left over from another stack. How many flyers does Nat have now?

In the morning Sol counted the trees in his orchard: 3 rows with 73 trees in each, plus 3 trees by the barn and 80 young trees in the new field. That is more trees than his neighbour Tom has in his whole orchard. In the afternoon Sol reckoned that every tree would fill 4 crates and that each crate holds 5 kilograms of fruit. In the evening, after the harvest came in exactly as he expected, he sold 1427 kilograms to a cider maker. How many kilograms of fruit does Sol have left?

In the morning the recycling centre received 9 crates of glass bottles with 216 bottles in each crate. The delivery lorry is 10 years old. In the afternoon a volunteer brought in 3 bottles from her car and a cafe dropped off 47 more. In the evening the centre paid out the deposit of 8 cents on every bottle it had received that day. How many cents did the centre pay out?

In the morning Vera filled 9 trays with 156 seedlings each in her first greenhouse, then added 76 seedlings from a spare tray and 14 seedlings that had sprouted in pots. In the afternoon she confirmed that all 4 of her greenhouses were stocked exactly like the first, and she planted 75 more seedlings by the door. In the evening Vera visited Wil's nursery, which has 3 times as many seedlings as Vera has in total, so Wil's nursery is much bigger than hers. How many seedlings does Wil's nursery have?

Yara brought 188 handmade mugs to the craft fair and sold 106 of them in the first hour. Her partner then delivered 70 more mugs, and she sold 146 mugs in the afternoon. The stall rent was 30 dollars. At closing time she sold every remaining mug to a cafe owner for 4 dollars each. How many dollars did the cafe owner pay?
